__inputs.name: DS_AZURE_MONITOR
__inputs.label: Azure Monitor
__inputs.description: Datasource Azure Monitor con acceso de lectura a Application Insights.

title: AI Tokens - Consumo y acceso unificado
description: Consumo de tokens, acceso A2A/APIM y fallos finales desde customMetrics, requests y exceptions de Application Insights. HTTP429 clasificado por API Type: a2a=request-rate-limit; http=llm-rate-limit, segun convencion del entorno.

list.label: Servicio APIM

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let IdentityContexts = customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Total Tokens")
| extend
    service = tostring(customDimensions["Service ID"]),
    agent = tostring(customDimensions["agent"]),
    product = tostring(customDimensions["product"]),
    subscriptionId = tostring(customDimensions["subscriptionId"]),
    department = tostring(customDimensions["department"]),
    team = tostring(customDimensions["team"]),
    user = tostring(customDimensions["user"]),
    model = tostring(customDimensions["model"]),
    Tokens = todouble(valueSum)
| extend
    service = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", service)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", service)),
    agent = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", agent)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", agent)),
    product = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", product)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", product)),
    subscriptionId = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)),
    department = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", department)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", department)),
    team = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", team)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", team)),
    user = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", user)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", user)),
    model = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", model)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", model))
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| where service != "(sin dimension)" and agent != "(sin dimension)" and subscriptionId != "(sin dimension)"
| summarize by service, agent, subscriptionId, department, team, user
| summarize MappingContexts = count(), mapped_department = take_any(department), mapped_team = take_any(team), mapped_user = take_any(user) by service, agent, subscriptionId;
let AgentRequests = requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where tostring(customDimensions["API Type"]) =~ "a2a"
| where tostring(customDimensions["HTTP Method"]) =~ "POST"
| extend
    service = tostring(customDimensions["Service ID"]),
    agent = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.id"]),
    product = tostring(customDimensions["Product Name"]),
    subscriptionId = tostring(customDimensions["Subscription Name"]),
    department = tostring(customDimensions["department"]),
    team = tostring(customDimensions["team"]),
    user = tostring(customDimensions["user"]),
    api = tostring(customDimensions["API Name"]),
    ApiType = "a2a", LimitType = "request-rate-limit",
    InvocationId = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["Request Id"])),
    Code = tostring(resultCode),
    Successful = coalesce(tobool(success), false),
    Represented = coalesce(tolong(itemCount), long(1))
| extend
    service = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", service)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", service)),
    agent = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", agent)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", agent)),
    product = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", product)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", product)),
    subscriptionId = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)),
    department = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", department)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", department)),
    team = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", team)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", team)),
    user = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", user)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", user)),
    api = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", api)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", api))
| join kind=leftouter IdentityContexts on service, agent, subscriptionId
| extend DirectComplete = department != "(sin dimension)" and team != "(sin dimension)" and user != "(sin dimension)",
    MappingComplete = MappingContexts == 1 and mapped_department != "(sin dimension)" and mapped_team != "(sin dimension)" and mapped_user != "(sin dimension)",
    IdentityConflict = MappingContexts == 1 and ((department != "(sin dimension)" and department != mapped_department) or (team != "(sin dimension)" and team != mapped_team) or (user != "(sin dimension)" and user != mapped_user))
| extend CanInfer = coalesce(MappingComplete and not(IdentityConflict), false)
| extend Attribution = case(
    DirectComplete, "directa",
    IdentityConflict, "conflicto",
    CanInfer, "inferida de metricas",
    MappingContexts > 1, "ambigua",
    MappingContexts == 1, "mapeo incompleto",
    "sin correspondencia")
| extend department = iff(department == "(sin dimension)" and CanInfer, mapped_department, department),
    team = iff(team == "(sin dimension)" and CanInfer, mapped_team, team),
    user = iff(user == "(sin dimension)" and CanInfer, mapped_user, user)
| project timestamp, service, agent, product, subscriptionId, department, team, user, api, ApiType, LimitType, Code, Successful, Represented, Attribution, InvocationId;
let RootRequests = AgentRequests
| where isnotempty(InvocationId) and service != "(sin dimension)"
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by service, InvocationId;
let RootContext = RootRequests
| project service, InvocationId, RootObserved = true, RootCode = Code, RootAttribution = Attribution,root_agent = agent, root_product = product, root_subscriptionId = subscriptionId, root_department = department, root_team = team, root_user = user;
let FinalFailures = exceptions
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where tostring(customDimensions["event"]) == "agent_invocation_failed"
| where tostring(customDimensions["schema_version"]) == "1"
| extend service = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["service"])),
    agent = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["agent"])),
    department = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["department"])),
    team = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["team"])),
    user = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["user"])),
    InvocationId = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["invocation_id"])),
    CorrelationSource = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["correlation_source"])),
    ErrorOrigin = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["error_origin"])),
    ErrorKind = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["error_kind"])),
    ModelCallId = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["model_call_id"])),
    model = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["model"])),
    TaskId = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["task_id"])),
    product = "(sin dimension)", subscriptionId = "(sin dimension)",
    UpstreamStatus = toint(customDimensions["upstream_status"]),
    RetryAfterSeconds = todouble(customDimensions["retry_after_seconds"]),
    Represented = coalesce(tolong(itemCount), long(1))
| extend service = iff(isempty(service), "(sin dimension)", service),
    agent = iff(isempty(agent), "(sin dimension)", agent),
    product = iff(isempty(product), "(sin dimension)", product),
    subscriptionId = iff(isempty(subscriptionId), "(sin dimension)", subscriptionId),
    department = iff(isempty(department), "(sin dimension)", department),
    team = iff(isempty(team), "(sin dimension)", team),
    user = iff(isempty(user), "(sin dimension)", user),
    model = iff(isempty(model), "(sin dimension)", model),
    ErrorOrigin = iff(isempty(ErrorOrigin), "(sin dimension)", ErrorOrigin),
    ErrorKind = iff(isempty(ErrorKind), "(sin dimension)", ErrorKind)
| join kind=leftouter RootContext on service, InvocationId
| extend Correlation = case(isempty(InvocationId), "sin invocation_id", service == "(sin dimension)", "sin servicio", coalesce(RootObserved, false), "raiz A2A exacta", "sin raiz A2A en intervalo")
| extend agent = iff(isnotempty(root_agent) and root_agent != "(sin dimension)", root_agent, agent),

let RootRequests = AgentRequests
| where isnotempty(InvocationId) and service != "(sin dimension)"
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by service, InvocationId;
let RootContext = RootRequests
| project service, InvocationId, RootObserved = true, RootCode = Code, RootAttribution = Attribution,root_agent = agent, root_product = product, root_subscriptionId = subscriptionId, root_department = department, root_team = team, root_user = user;
let FinalFailures = exceptions
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where tostring(customDimensions["event"]) == "agent_invocation_failed"
| where tostring(customDimensions["schema_version"]) == "1"

    agent = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["agent"])),
    department = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["department"])),
    team = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["team"])),
    user = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["user"])),
    InvocationId = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["invocation_id"])),
    CorrelationSource = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["correlation_source"])),
    ErrorOrigin = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["error_origin"])),
    ErrorKind = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["error_kind"])),
    ModelCallId = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["model_call_id"])),
    model = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["model"])),
    TaskId = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["task_id"])),
    product = "(sin dimension)", subscriptionId = "(sin dimension)",
    UpstreamStatus = toint(customDimensions["upstream_status"]),
    RetryAfterSeconds = todouble(customDimensions["retry_after_seconds"]),
    Represented = coalesce(tolong(itemCount), long(1))
| extend service = iff(isempty(service), "(sin dimension)", service),
    agent = iff(isempty(agent), "(sin dimension)", agent),
    product = iff(isempty(product), "(sin dimension)", product),
    subscriptionId = iff(isempty(subscriptionId), "(sin dimension)", subscriptionId),
    department = iff(isempty(department), "(sin dimension)", department),
    team = iff(isempty(team), "(sin dimension)", team),
    user = iff(isempty(user), "(sin dimension)", user),
    model = iff(isempty(model), "(sin dimension)", model),
    ErrorOrigin = iff(isempty(ErrorOrigin), "(sin dimension)", ErrorOrigin),
    ErrorKind = iff(isempty(ErrorKind), "(sin dimension)", ErrorKind)
| join kind=leftouter RootContext on service, InvocationId
| extend Correlation = case(isempty(InvocationId), "sin invocation_id", service == "(sin dimension)", "sin servicio", coalesce(RootObserved, false), "raiz A2A exacta", "sin raiz A2A en intervalo")
| extend agent = iff(isnotempty(root_agent) and root_agent != "(sin dimension)", root_agent, agent),
    product = iff(isnotempty(root_product) and root_product != "(sin dimension)", root_product, product),
    subscriptionId = iff(isnotempty(root_subscriptionId) and root_subscriptionId != "(sin dimension)", root_subscriptionId, subscriptionId),
    department = iff(isnotempty(root_department) and root_department != "(sin dimension)", root_department, department),
    team = iff(isnotempty(root_team) and root_team != "(sin dimension)", root_team, team),
    user = iff(isnotempty(root_user) and root_user != "(sin dimension)", root_user, user);
union (union (customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Total Tokens")
| extend
    service = tostring(customDimensions["Service ID"]),
    agent = tostring(customDimensions["agent"]),
    product = tostring(customDimensions["product"]),
    subscriptionId = tostring(customDimensions["subscriptionId"]),
    department = tostring(customDimensions["department"]),
    team = tostring(customDimensions["team"]),
    user = tostring(customDimensions["user"]),
    model = tostring(customDimensions["model"]),
    Tokens = todouble(valueSum)
| extend
    service = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", service)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", service)),
    agent = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", agent)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", agent)),
    product = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", product)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", product)),
    subscriptionId = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)),
    department = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", department)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", department)),
    team = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", team)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", team)),
    user = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", user)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", user)),
    model = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", model)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", model))
| where $__contains(service, $service)
| where $__contains(agent, $agent)
| where $__contains(product, $product)
| where $__contains(subscriptionId, $subscriptionId)
| where $__contains(department, $department)
| where $__contains(team, $team)
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| project user),
(AgentRequests
| where $__contains(service, $service)
| where $__contains(agent, $agent)
| where $__contains(product, $product)
| where $__contains(subscriptionId, $subscriptionId)
| where $__contains(department, $department)
| where $__contains(team, $team)
| project user)),
(FinalFailures
| where $__contains(service, $service)
| where $__contains(agent, $agent)
| where $__contains(product, $product)
| where $__contains(subscriptionId, $subscriptionId)
| where $__contains(department, $department)
| where $__contains(team, $team)

| order by user asc

| extend
    service = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", service)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", service)),
    agent = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", agent)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", agent)),
    product = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", product)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", product)),

| where name == "Total Tokens"
| where service != "(sin dimension)" and agent != "(sin dimension)" and subscriptionId != "(sin dimension)"
| summarize by service, agent, subscriptionId, department, team, user
| summarize MappingContexts = count(), mapped_department = take_any(department), mapped_team = take_any(team), mapped_user = take_any(user) by service, agent, subscriptionId;
let AgentRequests = requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where tostring(customDimensions["API Type"]) =~ "a2a"
| where tostring(customDimensions["HTTP Method"]) =~ "POST"
| extend
    service = tostring(customDimensions["Service ID"]),
    agent = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.id"]),
    product = tostring(customDimensions["Product Name"]),
    subscriptionId = tostring(customDimensions["Subscription Name"]),
    department = tostring(customDimensions["department"]),
    team = tostring(customDimensions["team"]),
    user = tostring(customDimensions["user"]),
    api = tostring(customDimensions["API Name"]),
    ApiType = "a2a", LimitType = "request-rate-limit",
    InvocationId = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["Request Id"])),
    Code = tostring(resultCode),
    Successful = coalesce(tobool(success), false),
    Represented = coalesce(tolong(itemCount), long(1))
| extend
    service = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", service)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", service)),
    agent = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", agent)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", agent)),
    product = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", product)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", product)),

    api = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", api)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", api))

| extend DirectComplete = department != "(sin dimension)" and team != "(sin dimension)" and user != "(sin dimension)",
    MappingComplete = MappingContexts == 1 and mapped_department != "(sin dimension)" and mapped_team != "(sin dimension)" and mapped_user != "(sin dimension)",
    IdentityConflict = MappingContexts == 1 and ((department != "(sin dimension)" and department != mapped_department) or (team != "(sin dimension)" and team != mapped_team) or (user != "(sin dimension)" and user != mapped_user))
| extend CanInfer = coalesce(MappingComplete and not(IdentityConflict), false)
| extend Attribution = case(
    DirectComplete, "directa",
    IdentityConflict, "conflicto",
    CanInfer, "inferida de metricas",
    MappingContexts > 1, "ambigua",
    MappingContexts == 1, "mapeo incompleto",
    "sin correspondencia")
| extend department = iff(department == "(sin dimension)" and CanInfer, mapped_department, department),
    team = iff(team == "(sin dimension)" and CanInfer, mapped_team, team),
    user = iff(user == "(sin dimension)" and CanInfer, mapped_user, user)
| project timestamp, service, agent, product, subscriptionId, department, team, user, api, ApiType, LimitType, Code, Successful, Represented, Attribution, InvocationId;
AgentRequests
| where $__contains(service, $service)
| where $__contains(agent, $agent)
| where $__contains(product, $product)
| where $__contains(subscriptionId, $subscriptionId)
| where $__contains(department, $department)
| where $__contains(team, $team)
| where $__contains(user, $user)
| summarize Peticiones = count(),
    HTTP429 = countif(Code == "429"),
    HTTP403 = countif(Code == "403"),
    Correctas = countif(Successful and Code !in ("429", "403")),
    OtrosFallos = countif(not(Successful) and Code !in ("429", "403")),
    Inferidas = countif(Attribution == "inferida de metricas"),
    SinIdentidad = countif(department == "(sin dimension)" or team == "(sin dimension)" or user == "(sin dimension)"),
    Representadas = sum(Represented)
| extend Porcentaje = iff(Peticiones > 0, 100.0 * HTTP429 / Peticiones, real(null))
| project Valor = Peticiones

Filtros: servicio, producto y subscription. Agente, identidad y Modelo no filtran estas peticiones; las dimensiones ausentes no se infieren desde tokens. Porcentaje = HTTP429 / peticiones HTTP, no peticiones A2A.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where tostring(customDimensions["API Type"]) =~ "http"
| where tostring(customDimensions["HTTP Method"]) =~ "POST"
| extend
    service = tostring(customDimensions["Service ID"]),
    agent = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.id"]),
    product = tostring(customDimensions["Product Name"]),
    subscriptionId = tostring(customDimensions["Subscription Name"]),
    department = tostring(customDimensions["department"]),
    team = tostring(customDimensions["team"]),
    user = tostring(customDimensions["user"]),
    api = tostring(customDimensions["API Name"]),
    ApiType = "http", LimitType = "llm-rate-limit",
    InvocationId = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["Request Id"])),
    Code = tostring(resultCode),
    Successful = coalesce(tobool(success), false),
    Represented = coalesce(tolong(itemCount), long(1))
| extend
    service = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", service)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", service)),
    agent = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", agent)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", agent)),
    product = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", product)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", product)),
    subscriptionId = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)),
    department = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", department)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", department)),
    team = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", team)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", team)),
    user = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", user)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", user)),
    api = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", api)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", api))
| where $__contains(service, $service)
| where $__contains(product, $product)
| where $__contains(subscriptionId, $subscriptionId)
| extend Attribution = iff(department != "(sin dimension)" and team != "(sin dimension)" and user != "(sin dimension)", "directa", "sin correspondencia")
| summarize Peticiones = count(),
    HTTP429 = countif(Code == "429"),
    HTTP403 = countif(Code == "403"),
    Correctas = countif(Successful and Code !in ("429", "403")),
    OtrosFallos = countif(not(Successful) and Code !in ("429", "403")),
    Inferidas = countif(Attribution == "inferida de metricas"),
    SinIdentidad = countif(department == "(sin dimension)" or team == "(sin dimension)" or user == "(sin dimension)"),
    Representadas = sum(Represented)
| extend Porcentaje = iff(Peticiones > 0, 100.0 * HTTP429 / Peticiones, real(null))
| project Valor = Porcentaje

    service = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", service)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", service)),

options.content: **Errores: intentos fisicos != invocaciones impactadas.** HTTP429 fisicos por capa usan solo servicio/producto/subscription; no prueban una policy ni cuota. Los fallos logicos usan filtros A2A excepto Modelo. Se cuentan por servicio + invocation_id, nunca por ID de llamada al modelo. **Sin excepciones significa ningun fallo instrumentado observado, no exito demostrado**: configurar exportador Application Insights exceptions y cabeceras APIM. La correlacion puede llegar tarde o quedar fuera del intervalo; revisar cobertura, sampling e IDs ausentes.

panels.title: Departamentos y equipos: impacto de HTTP429
panels.description: Solo A2A POST: HTTP429 se clasifica como request-rate-limit por convencion de API Type. No incluye limites LLM. Peticiones y HTTP429 son filas observadas; Representadas pondera itemCount (estimacion si hay sampling). Porcentaje = HTTP429 / Peticiones. HTTP403 no equivale a cuota confirmada. Inferidas identifica peticiones enriquecidas desde metricas; SinIdentidad tiene alguna dimension de identidad ausente. Modelo no filtra peticiones. Maximo 1000 filas.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let IdentityContexts = customMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where name in ("Prompt Tokens", "Completion Tokens", "Total Tokens")
| extend
    service = tostring(customDimensions["Service ID"]),
    agent = tostring(customDimensions["agent"]),
    product = tostring(customDimensions["product"]),
    subscriptionId = tostring(customDimensions["subscriptionId"]),
    department = tostring(customDimensions["department"]),
    team = tostring(customDimensions["team"]),
    user = tostring(customDimensions["user"]),
    model = tostring(customDimensions["model"]),
    Tokens = todouble(valueSum)
| extend
    service = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", service)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", service)),
    agent = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", agent)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", agent)),
    product = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", product)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", product)),
    subscriptionId = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)),
    department = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", department)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", department)),
    team = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", team)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", team)),
    user = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", user)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", user)),
    model = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", model)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", model))
| where name == "Total Tokens"
| where service != "(sin dimension)" and agent != "(sin dimension)" and subscriptionId != "(sin dimension)"
| summarize by service, agent, subscriptionId, department, team, user
| summarize MappingContexts = count(), mapped_department = take_any(department), mapped_team = take_any(team), mapped_user = take_any(user) by service, agent, subscriptionId;
let AgentRequests = requests
| where $__timeFilter(timestamp)
| where tostring(customDimensions["API Type"]) =~ "a2a"
| where tostring(customDimensions["HTTP Method"]) =~ "POST"
| extend
    service = tostring(customDimensions["Service ID"]),
    agent = tostring(customDimensions["gen_ai.agent.id"]),
    product = tostring(customDimensions["Product Name"]),
    subscriptionId = tostring(customDimensions["Subscription Name"]),
    department = tostring(customDimensions["department"]),
    team = tostring(customDimensions["team"]),
    user = tostring(customDimensions["user"]),
    api = tostring(customDimensions["API Name"]),
    ApiType = "a2a", LimitType = "request-rate-limit",
    InvocationId = trim(@"\s+", tostring(customDimensions["Request Id"])),
    Code = tostring(resultCode),
    Successful = coalesce(tobool(success), false),
    Represented = coalesce(tolong(itemCount), long(1))
| extend
    service = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", service)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", service)),
    agent = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", agent)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", agent)),
    product = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", product)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", product)),
    subscriptionId = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", subscriptionId)),
    department = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", department)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", department)),
    team = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", team)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", team)),
    user = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", user)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", user)),
    api = iff(isempty(trim(@"\s+", api)), "(sin dimension)", trim(@"\s+", api))
| join kind=leftouter IdentityContexts on service, agent, subscriptionId
| extend DirectComplete = department != "(sin dimension)" and team != "(sin dimension)" and user != "(sin dimension)",
    MappingComplete = MappingContexts == 1 and mapped_department != "(sin dimension)" and mapped_team != "(sin dimension)" and mapped_user != "(sin dimension)",
    IdentityConflict = MappingContexts == 1 and ((department != "(sin dimension)" and department != mapped_department) or (team != "(sin dimension)" and team != mapped_team) or (user != "(sin dimension)" and user != mapped_user))
| extend CanInfer = coalesce(MappingComplete and not(IdentityConflict), false)
| extend Attribution = case(
    DirectComplete, "directa",
    IdentityConflict, "conflicto",
    CanInfer, "inferida de metricas",
    MappingContexts > 1, "ambigua",
    MappingContexts == 1, "mapeo incompleto",
    "sin correspondencia")
| extend department = iff(department == "(sin dimension)" and CanInfer, mapped_department, department),
    team = iff(team == "(sin dimension)" and CanInfer, mapped_team, team),
    user = iff(user == "(sin dimension)" and CanInfer, mapped_user, user)
| project timestamp, service, agent, product, subscriptionId, department, team, user, api, ApiType, LimitType, Code, Successful, Represented, Attribution, InvocationId;
AgentRequests
| where $__contains(service, $service)
| where $__contains(agent, $agent)
| where $__contains(product, $product)
| where $__contains(subscriptionId, $subscriptionId)
| where $__contains(department, $department)
| where $__contains(team, $team)
| where $__contains(user, $user)
| summarize Peticiones = count(),
    HTTP429 = countif(Code == "429"),
    HTTP403 = countif(Code == "403"),
    Correctas = countif(Successful and Code !in ("429", "403")),
    OtrosFallos = countif(not(Successful) and Code !in ("429", "403")),
    Inferidas = countif(Attribution == "inferida de metricas"),
    SinIdentidad = countif(department == "(sin dimension)" or team == "(sin dimension)" or user == "(sin dimension)"),
    Representadas = sum(Represented)
    by department, team
| extend Porcentaje = iff(Peticiones > 0, 100.0 * HTTP429 / Peticiones, real(null))
| top 1000 by HTTP429 desc
